title: LMMS: free FL Studio alternative
caption:
FL Studio's cheapest edition costs $99 to make beats. LMMS does it for free 🎹

✅ Song editor to lay out drums, bass and melodies on one timeline
✅ Piano roll, beat sequencer and a mixer with unlimited channels
✅ 15+ synths built in, plus VST plugins and SoundFonts
✅ Full MIDI support, import and export MIDI files

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ LMMS is built for making beats and electronic music, not for recording vocals, and the stable version is a few years old (the big 1.3 update is in alpha). The $99 is FL Studio Fruity Edition, a one-time purchase
